sentences.hanzi: 重阳节快到了，小明和丽丽去爷爷家玩。
sentences.pinyin: Chóngyángjié kuài dào le, Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì qù yéye jiā wán.
sentences.english: The Double Ninth Festival was approaching, and Xiaoming and Lili went to their grandpa's house to play.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷正在厨房里准备做重阳糕。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye zhèngzài chúfáng lǐ zhǔnbèi zuò Chóngyánggāo.
sentences.english: Grandpa was in the kitchen getting ready to make Double Ninth cake.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽问爷爷：“爷爷，重阳糕是什么味道的？”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì wèn yéye: "Yéye, Chóngyánggāo shì shénme wèidào de?"
sentences.english: Lili asked Grandpa, "Grandpa, what does Double Ninth cake taste like?"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷笑着说：“重阳糕甜甜的，里面还有红枣和核桃呢。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye xiào zhe shuō: "Chóngyánggāo tián tián de, lǐmiàn hái yǒu hóngzǎo hé hétáo ne."
sentences.english: Grandpa said with a smile, "Double Ninth cake is sweet, and it also has red dates and walnuts inside."

sentences.hanzi: 小明和丽丽都很想吃，爷爷说：“你们想不想跟我一起做？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì dōu hěn xiǎng chī, yéye shuō: "Nǐmen xiǎng bù xiǎng gēn wǒ yīqǐ zuò?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili both really wanted to eat it, and Grandpa said, "Do you want to make it with me?"

sentences.hanzi: 两个孩子高兴地说：“好呀，好呀！”
sentences.pinyin: Liǎng gè háizi gāoxìng de shuō: "Hǎo ya, hǎo ya!"
sentences.english: The two children said happily, "Yes, yes!"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷先拿出糯米粉，放在一个大碗里。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye xiān ná chū nuòmǐfěn, fàng zài yī gè dà wǎn lǐ.
sentences.english: Grandpa first took out glutinous rice flour and put it in a big bowl.

sentences.hanzi: 他让小明和丽丽慢慢地加水，然后用筷子搅拌。
sentences.pinyin: Tā ràng Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì màn man de jiā shuǐ, ránhòu yòng kuàizi jiǎobàn.
sentences.english: He asked Xiaoming and Lili to slowly add water, then stir with chopsticks.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽问：“爷爷，水要加多少？”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì wèn: "Yéye, shuǐ yào jiā duōshǎo?"
sentences.english: Lili asked, "Grandpa, how much water should we add?"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“一点点加，面不要太湿，也不要太干。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye shuō: "Yī diǎn diǎn jiā, miàn bùyào tài shī, yě bùyào tài gān."
sentences.english: Grandpa said, "Add it little by little. The dough shouldn't be too wet or too dry."

sentences.hanzi: 小明搅了一会儿，手有点累，但是他还是很认真。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng jiǎo le yīhuìr, shǒu yǒudiǎn lèi, dànshì tā háishì hěn rènzhēn.
sentences.english: Xiaoming stirred for a while and his hand got a little tired, but he remained very serious and careful.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷笑了：“小明做得不错！”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye xiào le: "Xiǎomíng zuò de bùcuò!"
sentences.english: Grandpa smiled and said, "Xiaoming did a good job!"

sentences.hanzi: 然后爷爷把红枣和核桃切碎，放在糯米粉里，再放一些糖。
sentences.pinyin: Ránhòu yéye bǎ hóngzǎo hé hétáo qiē suì, fàng zài nuòmǐfěn lǐ, zài fàng yīxiē táng.
sentences.english: Then Grandpa chopped up the red dates and walnuts, put them into the glutinous rice flour, and added some sugar.

sentences.hanzi: 小明说：“爷爷，我喜欢吃甜的，可以多放点糖吗？”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shuō: "Yéye, wǒ xǐhuan chī tián de, kěyǐ duō fàng diǎn táng ma?"
sentences.english: Xiaoming said, "Grandpa, I like sweet things. Can we add a little more sugar?"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“可以，但是不要太甜，对身体不好。”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye shuō: "Kěyǐ, dànshì bùyào tài tián, duì shēntǐ bù hǎo."
sentences.english: Grandpa said, "We can, but it shouldn't be too sweet. Too much sugar is not good for your health."

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽把米粉放进一个小蒸笼里，轻轻地压平。
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì bǎ mǐfěn fàng jìn yī gè xiǎo zhēnglóng lǐ, qīngqīng de yā píng.
sentences.english: Lili put the rice flour mixture into a small steamer and gently pressed it flat.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷把蒸笼放在锅上蒸。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye bǎ zhēnglóng fàng zài guō shàng zhēng.
sentences.english: Grandpa placed the steamer on the pot to steam.

sentences.hanzi: 过了二十分钟，厨房里飘出了香味。
sentences.pinyin: Guò le èrshí fēnzhōng, chúfáng lǐ piāo chū le xiāngwèi.
sentences.english: After twenty minutes, a delicious smell drifted out of the kitchen.

sentences.hanzi: 小明闻到后，口水都要流出来了。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng wén dào hòu, kǒushuǐ dōu yào liú chūlái le.
sentences.english: When Xiaoming smelled it, his mouth was about to water.

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽说：“好香啊！一定很好吃！”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì shuō: "Hǎo xiāng a! Yīdìng hěn hǎochī!"
sentences.english: Lili said, "It smells so good! It must be delicious!"

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷把蒸笼拿下来，一块漂亮的重阳糕做好了。
sentences.pinyin: Yéye bǎ zhēnglóng ná xiàlái, yī kuài piàoliang de Chóngyánggāo zuò hǎo le.
sentences.english: Grandpa took down the steamer, and a beautiful Double Ninth cake was ready.

sentences.hanzi: 小明和丽丽看着糕，都很高兴。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì kàn zhe gāo, dōu hěn gāoxìng.
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili looked at the cake and were both very happy.

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷说：“这块糕，你们想自己吃，还是送给别人？”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye shuō: "Zhè kuài gāo, nǐmen xiǎng zìjǐ chī, háishì sòng gěi biérén?"
sentences.english: Grandpa said, "For this cake, do you want to eat it yourselves or give it to someone else?"

sentences.hanzi: 丽丽想了想，说：“我们家隔壁的李奶奶一个人住，她一定很喜欢吃重阳糕。”
sentences.pinyin: Lìlì xiǎng le xiǎng, shuō: "Wǒmen jiā gébì de Lǐ nǎinai yī gè rén zhù, tā yīdìng hěn xǐhuan chī Chóngyánggāo."
sentences.english: Lili thought for a moment and said, "Grandma Li next door lives alone. She would definitely enjoy eating Double Ninth cake."

sentences.hanzi: 小明点点头：“对！我们给李奶奶送过去吧。”
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng diǎn diǎn tóu: "Duì! Wǒmen gěi Lǐ nǎinai sòng guòqù ba."
sentences.english: Xiaoming nodded and said, "Right! Let's bring it over to Grandma Li."

sentences.hanzi: 爷爷非常高兴：“真是好孩子！”
sentences.pinyin: Yéye fēicháng gāoxìng: "Zhēnshi hǎo háizi!"
sentences.english: Grandpa was very happy and said, "What good children you are!"

sentences.hanzi: 小明和丽丽小心地把重阳糕放在盘子里，送给隔壁的李奶奶。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì xiǎoxīn de bǎ Chóngyánggāo fàng zài pánzi lǐ, sòng gěi gébì de Lǐ nǎinai.
sentences.english: Xiaoming and Lili carefully placed the Double Ninth cake on a plate and gave it to Grandma Li next door.

sentences.hanzi: 李奶奶打开门，看到糕，笑着说：“谢谢你们！你们真是懂事的好孩子！”
sentences.pinyin: Lǐ nǎinai dǎkāi mén, kàn dào gāo, xiào zhe shuō: "Xièxie nǐmen! Nǐmen zhēnshi dǒngshì de hǎo háizi!"
sentences.english: Grandma Li opened the door, saw the cake, and said with a smile, "Thank you! You are such thoughtful and well-behaved children!"

sentences.hanzi: 小明和丽丽听了，心里甜甜的。
sentences.pinyin: Xiǎomíng hé Lìlì tīng le, xīnlǐ tián tián de.
sentences.english: When Xiaoming and Lili heard this, they felt warm and happy inside.
